# My Little Pet
> A free pixel-art virtual pet by Teja Priyan: Windows desktop companion and installable Android/iPhone web app.

## Official information
- [Home](https://my-little-pet-cozy-companion.greenlarch1024.chatgpt.site/): Features and Windows download.
- [Guide](https://my-little-pet-cozy-companion.greenlarch1024.chatgpt.site/guide.html): Installation and factual answers.
- [Privacy](https://my-little-pet-cozy-companion.greenlarch1024.chatgpt.site/privacy.html): Local saves, backups, and hosting.
- [Terms](https://my-little-pet-cozy-companion.greenlarch1024.chatgpt.site/terms.html): Proprietary original code and assets; personal use permitted.
- [Repository](https://github.com/TejaPriyan/My-Little-Pet): Source and issue reporting.

## Product facts
Version 1.1.0. Windows 10/11 x64. Mobile is a web app, not an APK or IPA. The desktop pet can roam over other windows; mobile pets stay inside their app. Coins are earned, not purchased. Desktop and mobile progress do not sync. Offline mobile play requires a completed first online cache. The Windows installer is unsigned. Physical phone installation is not yet verified. Site access may require sign-in during private preview.

This file is a convenience summary, not an indexing guarantee or a license grant.
